checkpoint.selection_rule: FixedE200;two fixed-parameter coupled-envelope identities plus immutable energy source control;performance first: max four-seed sourceV/worstRX score;costs only if performance exactly tied;read-only24 oldpredictions;no test feedback

execution.stop_rule: Only own affected row fails on nonfinite/permissions/output collision/nonzero exit; preserve all artifacts; no retry, low-score stop or unrelated process intervention
